paragraphs.text: Toski is a small Cosmos monster from Kaldheim and the messenger of the gods .

Toski is a mischievous squirrel who serves Esika , the god of the World Tree . The size of a large dog (though tiny compared with the other Cosmos monsters), he scampers with unbelievable speed along the World Tree to bring news and carry messages between the Ten Realms . His small size allows him to observe events in all the realms and prize out secrets which he then carries back to Esika. Toski doesn't speak. He and Esika communicate by a mysterious form of telepathy, ensuring that the secrets that Toski brings to the god remain exactly that.
Toski would be compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
